steps.title: Refuse malformed signature fields
preconditions: Run tracer app -- test services billing with the trusted pinned local runtime.
Existing synthetic billing lifecycle, checkout and webhook chapters have completed. Local fixture only, outbound provider calls intercepted.
actions: POST /billing/webhook with t=-1 and 64-zero v1 digest
POST /billing/webhook with t=9007199254740992 and 64-zero v1 digest
POST /billing/webhook with t=1e3 and 64-zero v1 digest
POST /billing/webhook with current integer timestamp and v1=abc
POST /billing/webhook with current integer timestamp and 64-uppercase-A v1 digest
POST /billing/webhook with current integer timestamp and empty v1 digest

expectations.description: Six HTTP 400 invalid_signature replies preserve durable rows and provider-call count via unchanged assertions at lines 23–27.

mappings.why: Exercises timestamp validation and digest syntax filtering Local HTTP fixture observation. Manual association only.
